pages.text: A potted sunflower stood by the bakery window. Coco had grown it from a seed. The flower was already taller than Coco.
The dark seeds were ripening. Once they were ready, Coco would put them on bread.
Grandpa Mole lifted the pot. "The sun is that way. I'll move it for you."
The next morning, the window was empty. The pot was gone!
Coco looked around the alley. Grandpa looked around too. "Where did I put it...?"
There were many doors and walls in the alley, and many places to put a pot.
Coco looked up. A yellow flower peeked out from behind the corner of a wall.
It was the sunflower! The pot stood in a corner outside the wall.
Coco carried the pot back to the window. The seeds had ripened nicely and turned dark.
Coco sprinkled seeds over the bread. Grandpa stroked his whiskers. "Well, I must have picked a good spot after all."
